page.overview:
Who is Silva La Forge?

Silva La Forge was a female Human Starfleet officer who lived during the 24th century. By 2369, she became the captain of the . She was married to exozoologist Edward M. La Forge and had two children, son Geordi, and daughter Ariana.

La Forge and her husband spent time apart during their career. She was posted to multiple outposts near the Romulan Neutral Zone while Edward did research in the Modean system. () In 2369, she was given command of the Hera. ()

When Geordi was young, he lived with her and then with his father occasionally, instilling a familiarity with moving. () In 2340, La Forge and her husband helped Geordi get out of a fire he got caught in. After this, Geordi wouldn't let Edward and Silva get out of earshot. ()

In 2370, the Hera went missing. La Forge and the rest of the vessel's crew were listed as missing in action. Subsequent search missions by starships and revealed no trace of the ship's whereabouts or fate. She was survived by her husband and children. ()
